$comment: Supabase advisor findings we accept, with the reason. scripts/supabase-advisors.mjs fails on any ERROR or WARN not listed here. Match on lint name plus a substring of its detail. Owner: CTO.

accepted.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
accepted.reason: Intended API (ARCHITECTURE.md 0 rule 3 and 4.4): the one way a recipient reads a flare with mutual-friend names only. search_path is empty, execute is granted to authenticated only, the caller comes from auth.uid(), and 00_security and 05_flares test it.

accepted.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
accepted.reason: Intended API (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4): lists the caller's incoming flares without group fields. Same controls as flare_view.

accepted.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
accepted.reason: Clink has no passwords: email sign-in is off and users sign in with phone OTP, Apple or Google (ARCHITECTURE.md 5). The HaveIBeenPwned check only applies to password sign-ups, and it is a paid-plan feature (verify).

accepted.name: auth_insufficient_mfa_options
accepted.reason: ARCHITECTURE.md 5 has no in-app second factor in v1: the verified phone or the Apple or Google identity is the sign-in, and S-04 step-up is deferred to after beta. Turning on TOTP would expose factor enrolment the app has no screen for. Re-check when S-04 is revisited.

accepted.name: unused_index
accepted.reason: INFO only. clink-dev has no traffic yet, so every index reads as unused. Re-check on clink-prod after beta.
